newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi says 1998 CPI goal credible.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi says 1998 CPI goal credible.

text.p: Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Wednesday that Italy's target of 1.8 percent average inflation next year was credible.
Addressing the Italian banking association (ABI), Ciampi also said that the stability and strength of the lira raised expectations of a fall in short-term interest rates.
Ciampi said a consumer price index rate of 1.8 percent was "credible and achievable"
Preliminary inflation data from 11 sample cities published last Friday and Monday pointed to an inflation rate of 1.4 to 1.5 percent for June, down from 1.6 percent in May.
Ciampi said he expected short-term interest rates to fall.
"The stability and strength of the lira raise hopes of a reduction of short-term rates," Ciampi said.
